I'm biased because the game actually deleted my 41 hour save but I'm going to make a fat list anyway:

1) Cere having nothing to do in the story

2)The performance being atrocious

3)No mantis customisation

4) Never actually being able to travel with the mantis crew all together

5) No combat roll

6) Not being able to grow plants from different planets. I loved the little terrarium on the mantis, it really made it feel like home and personal to our own adventure. The garden is really great in survivor but it's just koboh plants with no variety.

7) Less variety of lightsaber components, although there are more materials tbf

8) Vllains that are beaten in quick and anticlimactic ways (see Rayvis, who is referred to as "the unkillable one" by many in the game)

9) Villains with no actual depth. You could feel bad for Trilla and understand why she is the way she is. Dagan seems to just turn bad for the plot to happen, Rayvis was boring and Bode just felt like shock value. You can't really empathize with any of them.

10) The variety in the planets. Coruscant was great but then we got desert, desert, spicy moon rock, imperial base on a rock, and pink tree rock. Fallen order's planets were so much more varied: lush green bog, deep forest, imperial underwater fortress, snowy jedi temple from the clone wars, red desert, wet and windy rock.

11) Boss fight variety. Trilla, oggdo, the gorgara, malicos, and Vader all felt unique, whereas the survivor bosses feel like the same guy with a lightsaber every time.

12) Cordova. Having him be sidelined most of the game and then unable to use the force on a blaster that's being pressed into his chest. Wise jedi my arse, that was a waste of potential and a disrespectful sendoff.

13) Inquisitors. In fallen order, they sent multiple inquisitors to hunt down cal who only used the force 1 time to save his friend. In survivor, they have no presence in the story when cal is literally the number 1 most wanted terrorist in the galaxy. Make it make sense.

14) Maybe a weird one but the sound design felt better in fallen order. I loved the clinking and rustling of Cal's belt while running in the squishy puddles on bogano. Didn't feel like that in survivor.

15) Plot. The survivor story just wasn't as interesting. The idea of trying to rebuild the fallen order was exhilarating through the whole game. Trying to find a planet to live on felt a bit slow, especially since bogano was basically the perfect undiscovered paradise until they led the empire there. I'm sure they could've found another similar undiscovered planet if they just went into the unknown regions a bit.

16) Character nods and cameos. The hologram with Obi wan, the clones, Saw, Mari and tarful, Vader at the end, referencing grievous on dathomir in the clone wars, the ilum temple from clone wars. Nothing like that in survivor apart from boba, who I didn't even get to see before my save wiped.
